row.evidence: LaunchDarkly's pricing page lists "SCIM user provisioning" under Enterprise (custom pricing), and the SCIM docs say "SCIM is only available to customers on an Enterprise plan."
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM gated to Enterprise (Contact Sales); Foundation is usage-priced ($10 per service connection/mo billed yearly, no seat fees), so per-user prices are null. SSO: the pricing card says "SSO and SAML are included on every plan" and the SSO docs reference Developer and Foundation SSO settings, while the comparison table marks SSO/SAML as Enterprise-only; sso_plan follows the card and docs (see conflicts). SCIM needs SSO first, OAuth2 client (not a PAT), one IdP per account; prebuilt SCIM apps for Okta and OneLogin, Entra is a manual SCIM setup (client ID/secret from Support). Group (team) sync only with Okta. SCIM DELETE deactivates and removes the member from the account; members added before SCIM/SSO cannot be deactivated via SCIM. REST member create/delete is blocked once SCIM is on. Audit log listed as Enterprise on pricing table.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: Unlimited seats; usage-based. SSO per pricing card and SSO docs; pricing comparison table says otherwise (see conflicts).

plans.name: Foundation
plans.price_text: $10 per Service Connection / mo (billed yearly); first 5 connections included
plans.notes: Also $8.33 per 1k client-side MAU/mo; no platform or seat fees.

auth.token_source: OAuth2 SCIM client: handled by the Okta/OneLogin catalogue app; for Entra or other IdPs, client ID and secret generated by LaunchDarkly Support

deprovision.data_retained: Member is deactivated and removed from the account and all teams; personal access tokens are deactivated on removal while service tokens they created stay active; owners cannot be deactivated.

custom.how: No new custom attributes; LaunchDarkly extension schema urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:launchdarkly:2.0:User carries role, customRole and customRolesArray.

roles.how: role (reader, writer, admin, noAccess) and customRole/customRolesArray attributes, root level or in the LaunchDarkly extension schema; team sync from Okta groups

limitations.text: Group (team) endpoints and team sync work only with Okta.
Only one IdP can be linked to an account at a time.
Members added before SCIM or SSO was enabled cannot be deactivated through SCIM.
After enabling SCIM, teams can no longer be managed in the LaunchDarkly UI.
Cannot create owners or deactivate the owner via SCIM; deactivated users cannot be updated until reactivated.
Entra ID and other IdPs need a manual SCIM setup with a client ID and secret from LaunchDarkly Support.

auth.notes: Personal or service access tokens in the Authorization header, scoped by role or custom role rather than OAuth-style scopes.

endpoints.purpose: Invite new members (blocked when SCIM is enabled)
Delete account member (blocked when SCIM is enabled)

audit_log_api.notes: Endpoint documented in the REST API; pricing table lists Audit Logging only under Enterprise.

rate_limits.text: Global per-account limit per ten seconds plus route-level and token limits; exact numbers not published (429 with X-Ratelimit headers).

limitations.text: Teams (and teamKeys on invite) are Enterprise-only.
Creating or deleting members through the REST API does not work once SCIM is enabled.

okta.notes: OIN page markup marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate, Group Push and Group Linking as checked.

entra.notes: Gallery app is SAML SSO with JIT; SCIM to Entra is configured manually against the generic endpoint.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Workspace per LaunchDarkly docs; accounts created on sign-in.

onelogin.notes: From LaunchDarkly's own OneLogin guide ("SAML 2.0, provisioning" app); OneLogin catalogue page not loaded.

fallbacks.notes: CSV export of members exists; no CSV import documented.

conflicts.text: Pricing card says "SSO and SAML are included on every plan" (and the SSO docs reference Developer and Foundation SSO settings), but the pricing comparison table shows SSO / SAML as "-- (2FA included)" for Developer and Foundation, with a checkmark only for Enterprise.

open_questions: SCIM docs do not say whether a deactivated member frees a billable seat (pricing is not per seat).
ServiceProviderConfig and ResourceTypes endpoints are not listed in the SCIM API docs.
JumpCloud catalogue listing not checked (jumpcloud.com blocks automated fetches).
Whether SCIM reactivation (active=true) is supported is implied but not stated explicitly.
SSO plan conflict between pricing card and pricing table (see conflicts).
